<link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">

Enter an amino acid motif in the field below to find the epitope of interest. Use * as a wildcard representing any single amino acid. 

<div class="search-box">
  <input id="searchInput" type="text" placeholder="Enter your motif here.">
  <button id="searchButton">Search</button>
</div>

<div class="cell">
<div class="cell-output-display">
<div class="datatables html-widget html-fill-item" style="width:100%;height:auto;"></div>
<div id="results"></div>
</div>
</div>


<script>
let data = [];
let resultsDataTable = null;

const CSV_FILE = "amyloids-additional-data.csv";
const STRING_COLUMN = "Sequence";
const NAME_COLUMN = "AGAMYID";

Papa.parse(CSV_FILE, {
  download: true,
  header: true,
  skipEmptyLines: true,

  complete: function(results) {
    data = results.data;

    const status = document.getElementById("status");

    if (status) {
      status.textContent = `Loaded ${data.length} rows.`;
    }
  }
});

function validateQuery(query) {
  if (!query) {
    throw new Error("Please enter a search pattern.");
  }

  if (!/^[A-Za-z*]+$/.test(query)) {
    throw new Error(
      "The search pattern may contain only letters and the * symbol (a wildcard)."
    );
  }
}

function wildcardToRegex(pattern) {
  return new RegExp(pattern.replace(/\*/g, "."), "gi");
}

function findMatches(query) {
  const regex = wildcardToRegex(query);

  return data
    .map(row => {
      const sequence = String(row[STRING_COLUMN] || "");
      const name = String(row[NAME_COLUMN] || "");

      if (sequence.search(regex) === -1) {
        return null;
      }

      return {
        sequence: sequence,
        name: name
      };
    })
    .filter(Boolean);
}

function highlightMatches(sequence, query) {
  const regex = wildcardToRegex(query);

  return sequence.replace(
    regex,
    match => `<strong class="sequence-match">${match}</strong>`
  );
}

function destroyResultsTable() {
  if (resultsDataTable) {
    resultsDataTable.destroy();
    resultsDataTable = null;
  }
}

function showError(message) {
  const container = document.getElementById("results");

  if (!container) {
    return;
  }

  destroyResultsTable();

  container.innerHTML = `
    <p class="search-error">${message}</p>
  `;
}

function renderResults(matches, query) {
  const container = document.getElementById("results");

  destroyResultsTable();

  if (matches.length === 0) {
    container.innerHTML = "<p>No matches found.</p>";
    return;
  }

  const rows = matches
    .map(match => `
      <tr>
        <td>${match.name}</td>
        <td class="sequence-cell">
          ${highlightMatches(match.sequence, query)}
        </td>
      </tr>
    `)
    .join("");

  container.innerHTML = `
    <table
      id="resultsTable"
      class="table table-striped table-hover"
      style="width: 100%;"
    >
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>Name</th>
          <th>Sequence</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        ${rows}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  `;

  resultsDataTable = $("#resultsTable").DataTable({
    pageLength: 10,
    searching: true,
    ordering: true,
    lengthChange: false,
    autoWidth: false,

    columnDefs: [
      {
        targets: 0,
        render: function(data, type) {
          if (type !== "display") {
            return data;
          }

          return `<a href="amyloids/${data}.html">${data}</a>`;
        }
      },
      {
        targets: 1,
        width: "80%"
      }
    ]
  });
}

function runSearch() {
  const searchInput = document.getElementById("searchInput");

  if (!searchInput) {
    console.error('Element with id="searchInput" was not found.');
    return;
  }

  const query = searchInput.value.trim();

  try {
    validateQuery(query);

    const matches = findMatches(query);

    renderResults(matches, query);
  } catch (error) {
    showError(error.message);
  }
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  const searchButton = document.getElementById("searchButton");
  const searchInput = document.getElementById("searchInput");

  if (searchButton) {
    searchButton.addEventListener("click", runSearch);
  }

  if (searchInput) {
    searchInput.addEventListener("keydown", function(event) {
      if (event.key === "Enter") {
        event.preventDefault();
        runSearch();
      }
    });
  }
});
</script>
